content.rendered:
Contact Us

Zetta Farms are technology-driven and process-oriented farm projects for sustainable farming of fruits & vegetables and are managed by agriculture experts and skilled farmers resulting in high yield of better quality produce thus reviving the agriculture economy and bringing global food sustainability.

  • Address
  • Office Hours
  • Mon-Fri: 10am –6pm
  • Call
  • Email

  • info@zettafarms.com
